title: KestrelCare Fee Schedule: Cancellation Fee by Reason
content:
| Reason on the cancellation request | Cancellation fee on a KestrelCare pro rata refund |
|---|---|
| vehicle total loss | none (0.00) |
| vehicle sold | 25.00 USD (the vehicle-sold fee) |
| any other reason, such as a customer request or a loan paid off | the plan's cancellation fee |

**Rule.** The cancellation fee on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts pro rata refund follows the reason on the cancellation request: a plan cancelled because the vehicle was a total loss carries no fee; a plan cancelled because the vehicle was sold carries the vehicle-sold fee; any other reason carries the plan's cancellation fee.

The reason is the one recorded on the holder's confirmed cancellation request for the plan.

*Hypothetical:* two KestrelCare Silver plans are cancelled pro rata on the same day, one because the car was sold privately and one at the holder's simple request; the first carries a fee of 25.00, the second the KestrelCare Silver cancellation fee.
